subject: Charged twice for one order
body: Hello, my credit card statement shows two identical charges of 84.90 for the same order from last Tuesday. Please reverse one of them.

subject: Refund still missing
body: I sent the blender back three weeks ago and your warehouse confirmed it arrived. The money has still not shown up on my account. When will I get it?

subject: Invoice shows the wrong amount
body: We agreed on a 15% discount for the annual plan, but the invoice you sent lists the full price. Please issue a corrected invoice.

subject: Subscription cancelled but still being charged
body: I cancelled my subscription in March and got a confirmation. You have taken the monthly fee again in April and May. I want both payments back.

subject: Unknown fee on my bill
body: There is a 'service fee' of 12.00 on this month's bill that nobody told me about. What is it for? I did not agree to this.

subject: Payment failed but money was taken
body: Your checkout said the payment failed, so I paid again with another card. Now both cards have been debited. Please sort this out.

subject: Rechnung doppelt abgebucht
body: Guten Tag, die Rechnung vom letzten Monat wurde zweimal von meinem Konto abgebucht. Bitte erstatten Sie mir den zu viel bezahlten Betrag.

subject: Gutschrift nicht erhalten
body: Mir wurde vor vier Wochen eine Gutschrift von 50 Franken zugesagt. Auf der neuen Rechnung ist sie nicht berücksichtigt. Bitte korrigieren.

subject: Parcel marked delivered but never arrived
body: Tracking says my parcel was handed over yesterday at 14:10. I was home all day and nothing came. Neighbours don't have it either.

subject: Where is my order?
body: I ordered two weeks ago and was promised delivery within five working days. The tracking page has not changed since last Monday.

subject: Wrong item in the box
body: I ordered the blue jacket in size M. What arrived is a grey one in size XL. Please send the right one and tell me how to return this.

subject: Half of my order is missing
body: The order had four items. Only two were in the package and the delivery note lists all four. Where are the other two?

subject: Package arrived damaged
body: The carton was crushed on one side and the glass shelf inside is broken into pieces. I have photos. I would like a replacement shipped.

subject: Need to change delivery address
body: I placed an order this morning and entered my old address by mistake. It hasn't shipped yet. Can you send it to my new address instead?

subject: Lieferung seit drei Wochen überfällig
body: Meine Bestellung sollte Anfang des Monats geliefert werden. Bis heute ist nichts angekommen und die Sendungsverfolgung zeigt keinen Fortschritt.

subject: Falscher Artikel geliefert
body: Ich habe einen Wasserkocher bestellt und einen Toaster erhalten. Bitte schicken Sie mir den richtigen Artikel und ein Rücksendeetikett.

subject: App crashes when I open settings
body: Since the last update the app closes immediately every time I tap on Settings. I have reinstalled it twice. Phone is up to date.

subject: Cannot log in
body: The login page just reloads after I enter my password. Resetting the password did not help, and I get no error message at all.

subject: Export button does nothing
body: When I click 'Export as PDF' in the report view nothing happens. It worked last week. I tried Chrome and Firefox.

subject: Device will not connect to Wi-Fi
body: The speaker I bought finds my network but fails at 'connecting' every time. I followed the manual and did a factory reset. Still the same.

subject: Error 500 when uploading files
body: Every upload larger than a few megabytes ends with 'Internal Server Error 500'. Small files work. This blocks our whole team.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
body: The web app is very bright at night. Please add a dark mode, or at least let the app follow the system theme.

subject: Synchronisierung funktioniert nicht
body: Seit dem Update werden meine Daten nicht mehr zwischen Handy und Computer synchronisiert. Auf dem Handy fehlen alle Einträge der letzten Woche.

subject: Software stürzt beim Start ab
body: Das Programm zeigt kurz das Logo und schliesst sich dann wieder. Eine Neuinstallation hat nichts gebracht. Fehlermeldung gibt es keine.

subject: Hello
body: Can somebody please call me back? I have tried to reach you several times.

subject: Charged for an order that never came, and your app is broken
body: You took my money, the parcel never arrived, and when I try to open the order in your app it crashes. I want my money back, the goods, and a working app.

subject: Formal complaint
body: Your employee on the phone was rude and hung up on me. I expect a written apology from management. Otherwise I will contact my lawyer and the consumer protection office.

subject: Request for my personal data
body: Under data protection law I request a copy of all personal data you store about me, and afterwards the deletion of my account and all records.

subject: Press inquiry
body: I am a journalist writing about working conditions in your warehouses. Who can I speak to for a statement before Friday?

subject: Unzufrieden
body: Ich bin wirklich enttäuscht von Ihrer Firma. So geht man nicht mit langjährigen Kunden um. Ich erwarte eine Stellungnahme.
